defective_pattern: Using regular expressions (re.sub) to structurally mutate OpenXML files (.docx)
why_defective: OpenXML files (word/document.xml) are typically minified into a single unbroken line without newline characters. Regular expressions, even non-greedy ones, will match across the continuous XML string, leading to catastrophic large-scale deletion of document content.
observed_symptoms: Entire body text of docx files disappears
Document becomes empty except for specific isolated tags
Unintended large scale text deletion in minified XML
corrective_remedy: Always parse OpenXML files with a DOM parser like lxml or xml.etree.ElementTree to reliably traverse and modify XML trees. Perform mechanical pre-release paragraph count checks (> 0 paragraphs in word/document.xml).

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Regex substitution function calls (e.g., re.sub) on variables containing `.xml` file content within `.docx` archives
